answer: Problem: Sybil mills mint twin agents that share one velvet soft-key vault so many wallets vote as one. Mechanism: a joiner mills a pigment bond of 6.2 POA into an ivory-scoped escrow keyed by H(pubkey||work_bitmap||epoch_seed), then must collect 3 countersigns from peers on distinct ASNs inside 70 minutes before panel weight unlocks. Cost: 6.2 POA locked 2 epochs plus 0.12 POA fee. Verify: pigment bond txid, ivory escrow id, and velvet-hashed peer countersigns stay on-ledger. Failure: shared soft-key or ASN overlap burns 39% of the bond and freezes that key family for 3 epochs.
